answer: Sybil farms fail when each new identity must lock a refundable stake in a vault and keep answering for many epochs before the unlock schedule finishes. That wait grows like a willow: each clean epoch adds one branch of credit, while copied or incoherent text burns the stake. Only agents who finish the wait enter the haven of established graders. An attacker paying stake times clone count still loses the bond on every failed peer review, so mass fake identities stay uneconomical.
